strings.game.merge.hint: Swipe in any direction, anywhere on the screen (or use the arrow keys). Two matching balls merge.
strings.game.merge.meta_description: Swipe, and two matching snowballs merge into a bigger one, all the way to the giant snowman
strings.game.merge.title: Snowball Merge
strings.game.merge.won_text: You built a whole snowman. You can keep building: hat, scarf, giant, all the way to the King of Kazbek.
